_comment: Staging fragment for ONE car-seat option. A parallel sourcing session copies this to <option-id>.json (filename MUST equal the option id in src/data/seed.json), fills it in, and commits ONLY this file + the image. Do NOT edit seed.json — the serial integration pass folds every fragment in and bumps dataVersion once. See ../../RESEARCH_PLAN.md.
name: Human-readable model name (must match seed.json)

verifiedAttributes._comment: Facts to fold into the option's attributes. Only the first four map directly into seed.json today; the rest are captured here as the audit trail / notes source.
verifiedAttributes.safety: one-line summary of headline safety features
verifiedAttributes.tacomaFitNotes: Any data found on fit in a Toyota Tacoma rear seat (rear-facing): seat-to-seat depth, recline footprint, 'fits 3-across', owner/CPST notes, or 'no direct data found'.

notes: Anything the integration pass should know: discontinued listing, regional-only, MSRP vs sale, bundle-only pricing, etc.
